cycleArithmetic: Kill length is NOT on the wiki. Assumed kill = 45 pre-enrage volleys + 8 specials (wiki: '~2400 health, ~2120 health, ~1820 health, ~1600 health, ~1310 health, ~1050 health, ~800 health and ~500 health for a special attack') + 8 bind projectiles + 2 landed double melees (standard play assumed to freeze/unbind 6 of 8 binds; wiki advice: 'immediately freeze the Whisperer, as she will run towards the player') + 10 enrage attacks (250 HP heal) = 73 cycles. The 8 bind cycles (8/73 = 0.110) carry no damage and are left unassigned, so the shares below sum to 0.888.

attacks.name: ranged volley
attacks.uncertainReason: share and leak rest on the assumed 73-cycle kill and assumed flick success per pattern; the wiki gives neither kill length nor hit rates
attacks.note: Strategies (Awakened): 'The Whisperer's regular attacks now consists of five projectiles rather than three.' 'Her regular magical attack can deal upwards of 45 damage, while her regular ranged attack can deal upwards of 53 damage.' 'Praying correctly fully negates the damage.' Infobox 'max hit2 = ... 53 ([[Ranged]])'. Patterns: start 'with two of one style and three of the other (e.g. R-R-R-M-M)'; 'After two specials, one, two, then two of the first style (e.g. R-M-M-R-R)'; 'After the seventh special, alternate every hit (R-M-R-M-R)'. Share: 45 volleys of 73 cycles, styles 50/50 -> 22.5/73 = 0.307 ranged-equivalent volleys (2.5 ranged + 2.5 magic projectiles per volley in expectation). Leak by HP band: 2700-1820 one-swap volleys (~0.08 per projectile), 1820-800 two-swap volleys (~0.15), 800-0 four-swap volleys (~0.30) -> 0.33x0.08 + 0.38x0.15 + 0.30x0.30 = 0.17.

attacks.name: melee (x2)
attacks.uncertainReason: infobox says '70+ (x2)', Strategies '50-72 ... if not prayed against' -> 72 used; share assumes 2 of 8 binds end in a landed double hit (no-freeze play would be 8/73 = 0.110)
attacks.note: Infobox 'max hit2 = 70+ (x2) ([[Melee]])'. Strategies (Awakened): 'Her regular melee attacks deals between 50-72 damage if not prayed against.' 'If prayed against, it deals between 37-52 damage.' -> prayerFactor 37/50 = 0.74, 52/72 = 0.72. 'This still respects normal mode modifiers' (two hits in two ticks, always hits, second mirrors the first). Avoidance per wiki: 'do not attack the Whisperer until she launches the binding projectile and stay at least 8 or more tiles away'; 'immediately freeze the Whisperer, as she will run towards the player'. Share: 8 binds per kill, 2 assumed to land -> 2/73 = 0.027. Leak 0.1 = Protect from Melee not up when she closes.

phases: Eight specials: '~2400 health, ~2120 health, ~1820 health, ~1600 health, ~1310 health, ~1050 health, ~800 health and ~500 health for a special attack'; each is followed by a bind and a melee attempt (stay '8 or more tiles away', freeze her). Volleys are five projectiles from the start: 'two of one style and three of the other (e.g. R-R-R-M-M)'; 'After two specials, one, two, then two of the first style (e.g. R-M-M-R-R)'; 'After the seventh special, alternate every hit (R-M-R-M-R)'. Enrage at 0 HP: 'she now heals from 140 to 250', 'starts with magic instead of ranged and also swaps styles after every attack', 'sends two or three tentacles every two attacks instead of one'; enrage attack speed not stated for Awakened (Normal: 2 ticks). Infobox attack speed 10 ticks (single value for all versions).
sanityOrOther: Awakened: 'Sanity does not restore outside of the Shadow Realm. While in the Shadow Realm, the sanity and prayer drain is increased to 4' (per tick). Tentacle hit -30% sanity; Screech 70 sanity per hit (five hits); Normal rules otherwise (0% sanity = insane, dead within 10 ticks). 'the player must essentially perfect every mechanic or they will go insane at some point during the fight.' Immune to stat drains implied by the Awakened set (not stated for the Whisperer specifically). Slayer tasks do not apply; 3/64 unique roll.
